taskVersion.name: ves-heldout-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station H-06 (survey area H). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 609.8 | 18.27 | 18.27
2 | 213.6 | 1.05 | 19.32
3 | 1311.8 | 4.54 | 23.86
4 | 278.0 | 3.10 | 26.96
5 | 1124.7 | 1.46 | 28.42
6 | 291.6 | - | -

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: H-06
Curve type: HKHKH (complex six-layer curve)
Aquifer depth: 23.86 – 26.96 m (low-resistivity layer 4, sandwiched between high-resistivity layers 3 and 5)
Recommendation: Plan drilling to at least 28–30 m, installing screen across the 23.86–26.96 m interval as the primary water-bearing zone; continue coring below 28.42 m to evaluate the underlying 291.6 ohm‑m layer as a possible secondary deeper aquifer.
